subject: Reuse admitted battle friends for the officer-alert gate
description: BattleDecisions correctly performed Original's 360-degree visibility checks while building the nearby-friend list, but the LookForHelp arm then scanned the camp and repeated those checks to recompute bAlertingSoldierNear. Original RHArtificialMalignity::BattleDecisions derives that flag inside the single mlistUs admission walk and reuses it before AlertOfficer. Rust now derives the flag from the already-admitted list, preserving the authoritative visibility results, query order, and cache state without admitting an out-of-view alerting soldier. The nicouzouf Profile_001 Savegame_041 replay-015 representative clears its frame-1038 visibility-query frontier and advances to an independent PC HitCmd/MoveOk frontier after frame 1078. Focused admitted/out-of-view controls pass, and both Task 36 schema-14 controls match exact EOF.
